meta.title: Laterite
meta.description: A capped, revocable autopilot from your stablecoin income into tokenized S&P 500, in your own wallet.

wallets.title: Choose a wallet
wallets.note: Phantom, Solflare or Backpack, on devnet.

errors.rejected: {wallet} did not connect: the request was declined.
errors.eligibility: Laterite could not check your declaration.

declaration.title: Before you start
declaration.note: A signature, not a transaction: no fee, nothing moves.
declaration.failed: The declaration could not be recorded.
declaration.unavailable: Laterite is not available in your region.

unavailable.label: Your region
unavailable.why: Laterite buys xStocks, and their issuer does not offer them in your region.

onboarding.label: If you get paid {amount}
onboarding.engineWeeklyHint: Buys once a week in US market hours: never on an NYSE holiday, nor after 1 p.m. New York time on an early close.
onboarding.changeHint: Rounds each payment you make up to the next dollar, $0.50 at least, times {times}.
onboarding.tokensHint: You can change tokens later in settings, without leaving.
onboarding.noTokens: No test dollars yet: the faucet creates both accounts.
onboarding.faucetLimited: The faucet already funded this wallet today.
onboarding.faucetFailed: The faucet could not mint test dollars.
onboarding.delegate: Your {token} account already lets {delegate} spend {amount}. Signing replaces that approval with Laterite’s capped one.
onboarding.exited: Coming back keeps your first enrollment: no new trial week, this week’s spending counts, and what waited to invest was discarded when you left.

problems.amount: Amounts are dollars and cents, like 20 or 12.50.
problems.delegate: Confirm replacing the existing approval first.
problems.engineAboveCap: The schedule cannot buy more than the weekly cap.
problems.engineAmount: Choose how much the schedule buys.
problems.faucetFirst: Get test USDC and USDT first.
problems.goalLabel: The goal’s name is too long: shorten it to 32 characters or fewer (accented letters count double).
problems.nothingInvests: Turn on the schedule, the income rule or change per payment.
problems.tier: That cap is above the beta’s limit.

closed.label: Enrollment
closed.receipt: Nothing can be signed until it reopens. Your wallet is untouched.

dashboard.empty: Nothing yet. Your first buy shows here.

errors.position: Laterite could not read your position.
errors.history: Laterite could not read your history.

permission.label: One permission

clauses.title: What the permission does
clauses.cap: Spends at most {cap} a week, in all.
clauses.capHint: Laterite’s program holds your buys to {cap} a week together{trial, select, yes {, {trialCap} in your first week} other {}}. The Subscriptions program holds {count, plural, one {your {tokens}} other {each of your {tokens}}} to {cap} a week.
clauses.asset: Only buys {asset}, into your own wallet.
clauses.elsewhere: Can’t send your dollars anywhere else.
clauses.exit: Pause or exit whenever you want.
clauses.price: Each buy is priced by Pyth, on-chain.
clauses.priceHint: A buy must bring at least what fresh Pyth prices, verified on-chain at the careful end of their range, say it is worth, less 0.55%. USDT counts at its own Pyth price, USDC at $1.

SPYx.summary: What is SPYx? A token that tracks the S&P 500
SPYx.body: An xStock: a token Backed Assets issues that tracks the SPDR S&P 500 ETF. On devnet it is a test copy with no value.

QQQx.summary: What is QQQx? A token that tracks the Nasdaq-100
QQQx.body: An xStock: a token Backed Assets issues that tracks the Invesco QQQ ETF. On devnet it is a test copy with no value.

permission.simulated: Tested on devnet: it goes through. You pay 0 SOL, Laterite {sol} SOL.

problems.rejected: You did not sign. Nothing was sent.
problems.modified: Your wallet changed the transaction, so Laterite did not send it.
problems.version: This wallet cannot sign this transaction. Try Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
problems.wallet: Your wallet could not sign. Nothing was sent.
problems.paused: Laterite’s program is paused. Nothing was signed.
problems.full: The beta is full. Nothing was signed.
problems.limited: Too many tries from this wallet or network. Try again in {wait}.
problems.asset-account: Laterite paid for your {asset} account once, and it was closed. Choose the other asset, or open that account again in your wallet.
problems.simulation: Devnet refused it in a test run ({program} error {code}). Nothing was signed.
problems.expired: It waited too long and expired. Sign again.
problems.network: Laterite could not reach devnet. Nothing was sent.
problems.other: Laterite could not sponsor this transaction. Nothing was sent.

declaration.us: I am not a U.S. person and I am not in the United States.

link.heading: Laterite notifications on Telegram
link.request: {domain} asks you to link a Telegram chat to this wallet. The chat will get your purchases, goal milestones and skipped days.
link.unlink: {domain} asks you to unlink every Telegram chat from this wallet.

replies.linked: This chat now gets Laterite's notifications for {wallet}. Send /unlink to stop them.
replies.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Link Telegram again from Laterite's settings.
replies.welcome: Link this chat from Laterite's settings to get your purchases, goal milestones and skipped days here.
replies.unlinked: This chat no longer gets Laterite's notifications.
replies.notLinked: This chat is not linked to a wallet.

notices.parts: {engine, number, ::currency/USD} on schedule and {pending, number, ::currency/USD} from your payments.
notices.capReached: This week's {cap, number, ::currency/USD} cap is reached: {waiting, number, ::currency/USD} waits for next week.
notices.waiting: {waiting, number, ::currency/USD} is still waiting to be invested.
notices.goal: You reached {percent}% of your goal “{label}”: {invested, number, ::currency/USD} of {goal, number, ::currency/USD} invested.
notices.goalUnnamed: You reached {percent}% of your goal: {invested, number, ::currency/USD} of {goal, number, ::currency/USD} invested.
notices.skipped: No {token} purchase on {day, date, ::MMMMd}: {reason, select, restore {the permission for {token} was ended outside Laterite. Restore it in the app to invest again.} pull {the payment could not be collected. Check your {token} balance and permission.} other {prices or routes were not available that day.}}
notices.paused: Paused: nothing is bought until you resume. What waits to be invested is kept.
notices.resumed: Resumed: Laterite invests for you again.
notices.tierChanged: Your weekly cap is now {cap, number, ::currency/USD}.
notices.exited: You left Laterite: every permission ended. This chat gets nothing more unless you come back.
notices.reactivated: Welcome back: Laterite invests for you again.
